question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical export and authoring format for the experimental Claw package lifecycle once the prerequisite stacked PRs are ready?
rationale: This is a new package-facing format and documentation contract rather than a repair to established main-branch behavior; the compatibility boundary and whether the experimental Claw lifecycle belongs in core require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked format
options.body: Keep the PR open, require current-head lifecycle proof, and review it after the prerequisite Claw stack is ready to land.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the exported format and close or narrow this PR if maintainers do not want a second human-authored manifest representation.

options.title: Pause the Claw program
options.body: Defer this and its prerequisite lifecycle PRs until maintainers confirm the broader experimental Claw product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked format
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require current-head lifecycle proof, and review it after the prerequisite Claw stack is ready to land.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor owns the coherent PR stack and can supply the requested proof and clarify the proposed manifest boundary; final product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
